text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Sunday as reported by the official Algerian news agency APS. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Some 70 delegates from 40 African countries meet on Sunday in Algiers to review African Youth Movement.
- President Zeroual's aides put last touches on political reform plan ahead of national conference between opposition parties and authorities.
- Government prepares economic conference to assess economy's performance.
